items.title: Gingerbread Ribbon Gymnast
items.alt: Gingerbread gymnast in a yellow icing leotard sweeping a rainbow ribbon around a one-legged balancing pose.
items.description: A purple hair bow and pink candy buttons accent the heart-shaped face, while the wide ribbon loop frames the raised leg.

items.title: Gingerbread King on a Candy Throne
items.alt: Square-headed gingerbread king with a gold crown and green icing cape seated on a red-and-green gumdrop throne.
items.description: A white icing moustache and pointed beard frame the smile, with a striped candy scepter held beside the chair.

items.title: Gingerbread Pair Around an Arched Frame
items.alt: Two different gingerbread characters peeking around an empty arched cookie frame decorated with white icing and holly.
items.description: The left figure wears a red cap, while its smaller companion wears a green bow and matching icing skirt.

items.title: Gingerbread Family Holding Hands
items.alt: Three gingerbread characters holding hands: a tall teal-vested figure, a small child in green overalls and a bonneted figure in a pink dress.
items.description: Their different heights, icing faces and scalloped outfits create a compact family grouping.

items.title: Gingerbread Beside a Blank Recipe Card
items.alt: Small gingerbread character in a red gingham apron and scalloped headband holding the edge of a blank cream card.
items.description: The wide rounded card has a fine double brown border, leaving its center clear for a short recipe or message.

items.title: Gingerbread Looking Through a Telescope
items.alt: Tall gingerbread figure in a starry navy cap and purple cape looking through a brass telescope on a wafer-patterned tripod.
items.description: One eye closes while the other meets the eyepiece, and the long cape curves behind the slim cookie body.
